title: Xanthe and the Deadline
author: Petra Oyelaran
blurb: Noor Quintana, a burnt analyst bounced from three agencies, has spent fifteen years following rules that keep getting rewritten. Then the safe house is listed for sale — with photos of the inside — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must trade the one secret worth killing for, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
